title: Bitcoin Core speeds up security fixes as 44% of surveyed nodes run unsupported versions
summary: Bitcoin Core merged a policy amendment on Oct. 22 that lets developers backport fixes for easily rediscovered vulnerabilities to every maintained release line and publish an advisory alongside them. A network snapshot from Oct. 18 shows that 3,671 of 8,422 self-reported Bitcoin Core peers (43.6%) ran release lines that had already reached end of life.… Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next.
